      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "/* Typography CSS for UFO Disclosure Document Effects */\n\n/* Import research-specific fonts for archival aesthetic */\n@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Special+Elite\u0026display=swap');\n@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@400;700\u0026display=swap');\n@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700\u0026display=swap');\n\n/* Font Family Hierarchy */\n/* Modern/Tech Interface (Main App) */\n.font-monument {\n  font-family: var(--font-monument), 'Monument Grotesk', sans-serif;\n}\n\n.font-monument-mono {\n  font-family: var(--font-monument-mono), 'MONUMENT GROTESK Mono', monospace;\n}\n\n.font-neue-haas {\n  font-family: var(--font-neue-haas), 'Neue Haas Grotesk', sans-serif;\n}\n\n.font-lukas {\n  font-family: var(--font-lukas-sans), 'Lukas Sans', sans-serif;\n}\n\n/* Research/Archival Interface (Noir Aesthetic) */\n.font-typewriter {\n  font-family: var(--font-special-elite), 'Special Elite', 'Courier New', monospace;\n}\n\n.font-handwriting {\n  font-family: var(--font-just-another-hand), var(--font-caveat), 'Caveat', cursive;\n}\n\n.font-anton {\n  font-family: var(--font-anton), 'Anton', sans-serif;\n}\n\n/* Fallback mono for technical data */\n.font-mono {\n  font-family: var(--font-monument-mono), 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;\n}\n\n/* Research Base Terminal */\n.font-research-terminal {\n  font-family: 'Martian Mono', var(--font-monument-mono), monospace;\n}\n\n/* Glitch Effects */\n.glitch-element {\n  position: relative;\n  display: inline-block;\n  animation: glitch-skew 1s infinite linear alternate-reverse;\n}\n\n.glitch-element::before,\n.glitch-element::after {\n  content: attr(data-text);\n  position: absolute;\n  top: 0;\n  left: 0;\n  width: 100%;\n  height: 100%;\n  background: inherit;\n}\n\n.glitch-element::before {\n  animation: glitch-anim-1 0.5s infinite linear alternate-reverse;\n  color: #ff0000;\n  z-index: -1;\n}\n\n",

Uses Monument Grotesk\n      'h1': 'text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight font-monument',\n      'h2': 'text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight font-monument',\n      'h3': 'text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug font-monument',\n      'h4': 'text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug font-monument',\n      'h5': 'text-xl md:text-2xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-snug font-monument',\n      'h6': 'text-lg md:text-xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-snug font-monument',\n      \n      // Dystopian/Dramatic Headings\n      'heading-main': 'text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none font-monument transform hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300',\n      'heading-distorted': 'text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-widest leading-none font-monument transform scale-x-110 skew-x-[-5deg]',\n      'heading-classified': 'text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider leading-none relative font-monument classified-stamp',\n      \n      // Body Text - Using Neue Haas and Lukas Sans\n      'body': 'text-base leading-normal font-neue-haas',\n      'body-large': 'text-lg leading-relaxed font-neue-haas',\n      'body-small': 'text-sm leading-normal font-neue-haas',\n      'caption': 'text-xs leading-tight font-lukas tracking-wide uppercase opacity-70',\n      \n      // Technical/Data Display -       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "- **Next-level tweak:**\n  - Peel back a corner of the manila to reveal scrawled engineer notes underneath.\n  - Slap on a few Polaroids or clipped-together micro-film strips at the top.\n\n---\n\n## **5. Combined Moodboard Notes**\n\n- **Fonts:** Courier New / OCR-A for body text; a messy italic script (think fountain pen) for marginalia.\n- **Tokens to sprinkle:**\n  - Torn masking-tape edges, brass binder clips, red string connecting Polaroids.\n  - Stenciled “TOP SECRET” or “EYES ONLY” bars, half-erased pencil scrawls.\n- **Color accents:** Keep the base mono-beige / charcoal / cream, then pop neon-cyan or hot-magenta HUD highlights on key nodes.\n- **UI overlay:** Tiny glitchy HUD bits (pulse-sync bars, wireframe globe, radial scan reticle) at 10–20% opacity so they feel like digital ghosts haunting the analog.\n\n---\n\n**Bottom line:** you’re 85% there—just layer in those physical tokens (tape, clips, red string) *and* the futuristic micro-UI flourishes. That analog/digital tension is your secret sauce. 🍸\n\n## Fonts\n\n- Special Elite\n- Anton\n- Caveat\n- PP Neue Montreal\n- Monument Grotesk\n- Monument Grotesk Mono\n- Neue Haas Grotesk\n- Just Another Hand\n- JetBrains Mono\n- Courier New\n- Martian Mono\n- Lukas Sans\n- Noto Sans\n- Courier New / OCR-A\n\n---\n\nimport { Special_Elite, Anton, Caveat } from 'next/font/google';\n\nPP Neue Montreal\n\nexport const FONT_SPECIAL_ELITE = Special_Elite({\n  weight: ['400'],\n  subsets: ['latin'],\n  variable: '--font-special-elite',\n  display: 'swap',\n});\n\nexport const FONT_ANTON = Anton({\n  weight: ['400'],\n  subsets: ['latin'],\n  variable: '--font-anton',\n  display: 'swap',\n});\n\nexport const FONT_CAVEAT = Caveat({\n  weight: ['400', '700'],\n  subsets: ['latin'],\n  variable: '--font-caveat',\n  display: 'swap',\n});\n\nMonument Grotesk, Monument Grotesk Mono, Neue Haas Grotesk, Caveat, Just Another Hand, JetBrains Mono, Courier New, Martian Mono, Special Elite, Anton, Lukas Sans\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 111,
            "text": "- **What’s working:**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112,
            "text": "  - Genuine archival folder cover—typewriter title, stamped received date, official seal."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113,
            "text": "- **Next-level tweak:**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114,
            "text": "  - Peel back a corner of the manila to reveal scrawled engineer notes underneath."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115,
            "text": "  - Slap on a few Polaroids or clipped-together micro-film strips at the top."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119,
            "text": "## **5. Combined Moodboard Notes**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "- **Fonts:** Courier New / OCR-A for body text; a messy italic script (think fountain pen) for marginalia."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "- **Tokens to sprinkle:**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123,
            "text": "  - Torn masking-tape edges, brass binder clips, red string connecting Polaroids."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "  - Stenciled “TOP SECRET” or “EYES ONLY” bars, half-erased pencil scrawls."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "- **Color accents:** Keep the base mono-beige / charcoal / cream, then pop neon-cyan or hot-magenta HUD highlights on key nodes."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,
            "text": "- **UI overlay:** Tiny glitchy HUD bits (pulse-sync bars, wireframe globe, radial scan reticle) at 10–20% opacity so they feel like digital ghosts haunting the analog."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {

        "originalContents": "- **Next-level tweak:**\n  - Peel back a corner of the manila to reveal scrawled engineer notes underneath.\n  - Slap on a few Polaroids or clipped-together micro-film strips at the top.\n\n---\n\n## **5. Combined Moodboard Notes**\n\n- **Fonts:** Courier New / OCR-A for body text; a messy italic script (think fountain pen) for marginalia.\n- **Tokens to sprinkle:**\n  - Torn masking-tape edges, brass binder clips, red string connecting Polaroids.\n  - Stenciled “TOP SECRET” or “EYES ONLY” bars, half-erased pencil scrawls.\n- **Color accents:** Keep the base mono-beige / charcoal / cream, then pop neon-cyan or hot-magenta HUD highlights on key nodes.\n- **UI overlay:** Tiny glitchy HUD bits (pulse-sync bars, wireframe globe, radial scan reticle) at 10–20% opacity so they feel like digital ghosts haunting the analog.\n\n---\n\n**Bottom line:** you’re 85% there—just layer in those physical tokens (tape, clips, red string) *and* the futuristic micro-UI flourishes. That analog/digital tension is your secret sauce. 🍸\n\n## Fonts\n\n- Special Elite\n- Anton\n- Caveat\n- PP Neue Montreal\n- Monument Grotesk\n- Monument Grotesk Mono\n- Neue Haas Grotesk\n- Just Another Hand\n- JetBrains Mono\n- Courier New\n- Martian Mono\n- Lukas Sans\n- Noto Sans\n- Courier New / OCR-A\n\n---\n\nimport { Special_Elite, Anton, Caveat } from 'next/font/google';\n\nPP Neue Montreal\n\nexport const FONT_SPECIAL_ELITE = Special_Elite({\n  weight: ['400'],\n  subsets: ['latin'],\n  variable: '--font-special-elite',\n  display: 'swap',\n});\n\nexport const FONT_ANTON = Anton({\n  weight: ['400'],\n  subsets: ['latin'],\n  variable: '--font-anton',\n  display: 'swap',\n});\n\nexport const FONT_CAVEAT = Caveat({\n  weight: ['400', '700'],\n  subsets: ['latin'],\n  variable: '--font-caveat',\n  display: 'swap',\n});\n\nMonument Grotesk, Monument Grotesk Mono, Neue Haas Grotesk, Caveat, Just Another Hand, JetBrains Mono, Courier New, Martian Mono, Special Elite, Anton, Lukas Sans\n",

        "contents": "# Typography System\n\nComprehensive typography components for UFO disclosure documents and dystopian interfaces.\n\n## Components\n\n### Typography (Base Component)\n\nThe core typography component with extensive customization options:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { Typography } from '@/components/design-system/typography'\n\n\u003cTypography \n  variant=\"heading-main\"\n  as=\"h1\" \n  glitch={true}\n  rotation={-5}\n  className=\"mb-4\"\n\u003e\n  UFO DISCLOSURE\n\u003c/Typography\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Props:**\n- &#96;variant&#96;: Predefined styling variants\n- &#96;size&#96;: Text size override ('xs' to '6xl') \n- &#96;weight&#96;: Font weight ('light' to 'black')\n- &#96;align&#96;: Text alignment ('left', 'center', 'right', 'justify')\n- &#96;transform&#96;: Text transformation ('uppercase', 'lowercase', etc.)\n- &#96;as&#96;: HTML element to render ('p', 'h1', 'span', etc.)\n- &#96;glitch&#96;: Enable glitch animation effect\n- &#96;rotation&#96;: Rotation angle in degrees (-45 to 45)\n\n### Convenience Components\n\nPre-configured components for common use cases:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { \n  Heading, \n  SubHeading, \n  DataLabel, \n  DataValue, \n  HandwrittenNote, \n  Code \n} from '@/components/design-system/typography'\n\n\u003cHeading\u003eROSWELL INCIDENT\u003c/Heading\u003e\n\u003cSubHeading\u003eInvestigation Summary\u003c/SubHeading\u003e\n\u003cDataLabel\u003eCASE FILE NO.\u003c/DataLabel\u003e\n\u003cDataValue\u003eUFO-1947-07-08-001\u003c/DataValue\u003e\n\u003cHandwrittenNote rotation={-2}\u003eAgent's personal note\u003c/HandwrittenNote\u003e\n\u003cCode\u003econst classified = \"PROJECT_BLUE_BOOK\";\u003c/Code\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Variants\n\n### Document Headings\n\n**heading-main**\n- Usage: Primary document titles\n- Style: 6xl-7xl, black weight, uppercase, tracking-tighter\n- Effects: Hover scale transition\n\n**heading-distorted** \n- Usage: Dramatic emphasis headings\n- Style: 5xl-6xl, black weight, wide tracking\n- Effects: Scale-x and skew transforms\n\n**heading-classified**\n- Usage: Classification markings  \n- Style: 4xl-5xl, black weight, red color\n- Effects: Relative positioning for stamps\n\n### Subheadings\n\n**subheading**\n- Usage: Section headers\n- Style: 2xl-3xl, bold, uppercase, wide tracking\n\n**subheading-glitch**\n",

        "contents": "// Renders with: style={{ transform: 'rotate(-15deg)' }}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom CSS Classes\n\nAdditional utility classes available:\n\n- &#96;.text-fragment&#96;: Subtle blur and letter-spacing\n- &#96;.text-aged&#96;: Contrast and sepia filters\n- &#96;.text-typewriter&#96;: Typewriter animation effect\n- &#96;.text-on-paper&#96;: Paper texture overlay\n- &#96;.classified-stamp&#96;: Classification stamp styling\n- &#96;.redacted-text&#96;: Animated redaction effect\n- &#96;.scan-line-text&#96;: Scanning animation overlay\n- &#96;.text-shadow-glow&#96;: Glowing text effect\n- &#96;.text-gradient-fire&#96;: Fire gradient text\n- &#96;.text-gradient-classified&#96;: Classification gradient\n\n## Typography Scale\n\nThe system uses a consistent scale:\n\n| Size | Tailwind | rem | px (16px base) |\n|------|----------|-----|----------------|\n| xs   | text-xs  | 0.75 | 12px |\n| sm   | text-sm  | 0.875 | 14px |\n| base | text-base| 1    | 16px |\n| lg   | text-lg  | 1.125| 18px |\n| xl   | text-xl  | 1.25 | 20px |\n| 2xl  | text-2xl | 1.5  | 24px |\n| 3xl  | text-3xl | 1.875| 30px |\n| 4xl  | text-4xl | 2.25 | 36px |\n| 5xl  | text-5xl | 3    | 48px |\n| 6xl  | text-6xl | 3.75 | 60px |\n\n## Font Families\n\n- **Default**: System font stack\n- **Mono**: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace\n- **Handwriting**: 'Kalam', cursive, sans-serif\n\nFonts are loaded via Google Fonts in typography.css.\n\n## Responsive Behavior\n\nTypography automatically scales on different screen sizes:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Responsive heading sizes\n\u003cTypography variant=\"heading-main\" className=\"text-4xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl\"\u003e\n  Responsive Title\n\u003c/Typography\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nVariants include responsive breakpoints:\n- Mobile: Smaller font sizes\n- Tablet (md:): Medium sizes  \n- Desktop (lg:): Full sizes\n\n## Accessibility\n\n- **Color contrast**: All text meets WCAG AA standards\n- **Focus indicators**: Focusable elements have clear focus states\n- **Screen readers**: Semantic HTML elements with proper roles\n- **Reduced motion**: Respects prefers-reduced-motion for animations\n\n## Examples\n\n### Case File Header\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n",
